next_decision_reason: Widening the thermostat deadband by setting the occupied heating setpoint to 20.0°C and cooling setpoint to 24.5°C significantly reduces both heating and cooling energy usage while maintaining comfort within the required bounds.
Expanding the deadband by raising cooling setpoint to 24.5°C and maintaining heating setpoint at 20.0°C minimizes concurrent heating/cooling demand while preserving occupant thermal comfort.
